composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. creative_direction: Create a small old stone amphitheater after rain. Use only a few broad seating tiers, their curves leading to an empty central floor. Render wet stone reflections and gentle erosion, with no people, statues, or debris. Use detailed landscape architecture art. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
